questions.response: Personal Loan is unsecured credit for any personal need. No collateral required. Required: Name, Mobile, Email, DOB, Gender, City, State, Employment Type, Company, Occupation, Experience, Income, EMI, Loans, Credit Score, Bank, Loan Amount, Tenure, Purpose, Address, Pincode. Apply via Services > Credit.

Home Loan for buying, building, or renovating property. Same requirements as Personal Loan plus: Property Type, Value, Age, and Location. Typically lower interest rates than personal loans. Apply via Services > Credit > Home Loan.

Education Loan covers tuition, accommodation, and related costs. Lighter requirements than other loans. Need: Personal info, Income, Credit score, Course & institution details, Fees amount, Loan needed. Apply via Services > Credit > Education Loan.

Business Loan for startups and existing businesses. Required: Personal info, Employment details, Income, Credit score, plus Business Name, Type, Vintage, Turnover, and GSTIN. Flexible tenure and competitive rates. Apply via Services > Credit > Business Loan.

Credit Score reflects loan repayment history (0-900). Higher score = better approval chances and lower interest rates. Scores 750+ are excellent, 650-750 good, below 650 may face rejection. Build score by paying bills on time.

EMI (Equated Monthly Installment) is your fixed monthly loan payment. Calculated as: EMI = (P × R × T) / (T - 1) where P=Principal, R=Monthly Rate, T=Total months. Use our EMI Calculator in Services for exact amount.

General requirements: Age 21-60, stable income (min ₹15,000/month), good credit score (650+), Indian resident with identity proof. Some variation per loan type. Check Eligibility Checker in Services section.

Common documents: Aadhaar, PAN, Passport photo, Salary slips (3 months), Bank statements (6 months). For Business: GST certificate, Trade license, Income tax returns. Check specific requirements when applying.
Interest rates typically: Personal 8-15%, Home 6-9%, Education 7-11%, Business 8-16%. Rates vary by credit score, tenure, and bank partner. Use Interest Rate Comparison tool to compare across banks.
Processing: 3-7 days for approval, 1-3 days disbursement after approval. Fast-track: 24 hours possible for excellent credit scores. Track status in Submissions section.
Most loans allow early repayment. Some may have prepayment charges (typically 1-3%). Early repayment saves interest. Check loan terms before applying.
Loan: Large amount, long term, fixed EMI, lower rate. Credit Card: Smaller amount, revolving limit, flexible repayment, higher rate. Choose loan for big purchases, card for daily expenses.
